COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.1426 of 2023
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Lalit Samant, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Narayan Dutt, learned Brief Holder for 
the State.
3. By means of this writ petition, the petitioner 
has challenged the order dated 13.10.2022, passed 
by respondent no.4, which is Annexure no.10 to the 
writ petition, whereby services of the petitioner as 
Assistant Teacher (Primary) were terminated and
the order dated 18.11.2022, passed by respondent 
no.3, which is Annexure No.12 to the writ petition, 
whereby the appeal against termination order was 
also dismissed.
4. Learned counsel for the State prays for and is 
granted six weeks’ time for filing counter affidavit.
5. Further two weeks’ is granted to learned 
counsel for the petitioner for filing rejoinder 
affidavit.
6. List this case on 16.10.2023.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
